Adds bounded `error.type` to new and duplicate RPC telemetry for terminal failures while preserving legacy output.

- **gRPC:** Classify terminal status codes by client/server role; omit server cancellations.
- **Thrift:** Classify serialized failures as `_OTHER` when no throwable survives, retaining more-specific classifications otherwise.
- **Metrics:** Include `error.type` in advice for new RPC duration histograms only.
- **Dubbo:** End provider spans on asynchronous completion across supported 2.7 API shapes.
metadata.title: Capture terminal error.type for new RPC telemetry
